::: {#exr-racket-member}
#### Looking up a pair

In Racket, the relation $B$ of @exm-beats can be stored as a list of two-element lists:

```racket
(define beats
  (list (list 'rock 'scissors)
        (list 'scissors 'paper)
        (list 'paper 'rock)))
```

`(member x L)` returns `#f` when `x` is not an element of the list `L`.
Does `(member (list 'rock 'paper) beats)` return `#f`?

:::
